description: Requires an API key. No effect: how much USDT a PIX costs. Send EITHER brl_amount (what the recipient receives, in BRL, e.g. "50.00") OR br_code (a PIX Copia e Cola code; amount and recipient come from it). Returns usdt_total (estimated debit) and usdt_reserved (held until the PIX completes; the leftover returns). With br_code it also returns merchant_name and quote_id — show merchant_name to the user before paying. The quote is redone on payment. The minimum PIX is min_payment_brl from lunium_get_usdt_wallet.

br_code.description: PIX Copia e Cola code starting with 000201. Do not send together with brl_amount.

brl_amount.description: BRL the recipient receives, e.g. "50.00". Do not send together with br_code.

name: lunium_quote_pix_with_usdt
title: Quote a PIX paid with the USDT balance
